annotations.title: Install or Update Game Server Plugin

description: Install a plugin from list_gameserver_plugins (provider + projectId), with its required dependencies. With the versionId of an installed plugin it updates or downgrades it. The server must be stopped. Requires confirm=true. Returns an operation (get_operation_status) and the installationId. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: install_gameserver_plugin
